gen-gf-bellota-ibm-plex-serif: IBM Plex Serif has a faint thick-thin rhythm, like crayon on rough paper, with a loose c that never clamps shut. Bellota draws everything at one stylus width and hangs its s ends far out, so the two feel quirky beside authoritative.
gen-gf-bellota-text-crimson-pro: Refined and a bit stubborn, Bellota Text holds every stroke to one width with no shading at all. Crimson Pro answers with lightly engraved brass contrast, tightly packed.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-neco: Bellota Text draws tubelike, constant-weight lines that feel friendly and a little bold. Neco sits between monoline and sharp contrast, swelling gently from hairline to stem, so the pair reads dignified yet distinctive.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-recia: Bellota Text has essentially zero stroke contrast, every line the same. Recia, a text serif, keeps real weight even in its thinnest curves, so bump its size up a notch if the light modulation gets lost.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alegreya: Alegreya reads literary, like a classic serif with the tempered contrast of flexed spring wire. Bellota Text sets its horizontals as thick as its verticals, and that blunt, open lettering sits easily against the bookish texture below.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alegreya-sc: Alegreya SC, a text serif, keeps its s wide open and lets weight drift subtly along each curve. And Bellota Text, drawn with one constant pen width, gives that traditional voice a plainspoken, commanding partner.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alike-angular: Cut ribbon meets quiet tradition. Bellota Text keeps constant width throughout, while Alike Angular, a text serif, adds a subtle thick-thin cadence and holds its letters open, so each font gets its own say.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-alyamama: Alyamama, a text serif, reads refined and traditional, with curve endings kept well apart and a soft thick-thin difference. Bellota Text, traced with one thickness, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ancizar-serif: Ancizar Serif reads bookish and editorial, a classic serif with a visibly gaping c. Bellota Text offers a constant-width outline you could follow with a finger, which sets off the thinner curves below it nicely.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-andada-pro: Bellota Text traces each letter with a line of constant weight, open and commanding. Andada Pro, a text serif, varies its strokes modestly, so the two feel like a bold statement followed by a bookish murmur.
